next_step_summary: PR #255 adds the first smart-analysis evaluation corpus: 14 sanitized/synthetic semantic counterexamples with explicit expected states and cross-clause outcomes. The corpus covers CONFIRMED/NARROWED/CLEARED resolution, repeatable security identity, missing dependencies, template versus executed blanks, handwriting dependency without reconstruction, distant-clause composition, contradictory role references, option consent structure, materially relevant ABSENT behavior, and condition-appendix dependency. It is an evaluation oracle, not training data and not a generic lease-summary corpus. The next bounded step is a security-focused provider experiment using only this sanitized/synthetic material to learn what the LLM↔Python contract actually needs before wider runtime work.
